status: Candidate designs requiring detector validation; no new phrases have been encoded or selected as winners.

items.rubric: Visible corrective-style clear lenses or frames; sunglasses are a separate category; occluded/ambiguous is unclear.
items.falsifier: Top retrieval is dominated by sunglasses or absence score orders unrelated facial traits.
items.evidence: Hypothesis informed by eyewear literature; intelligence utility must be measured on this dataset.

alternatives: a face with both eyes clearly visible
items.rubric: Distinguish dark lenses, reflective lenses, frame-only occlusion, and eyes hidden by hair/shadow.
items.falsifier: Detects generic dark regions without localizing eyewear.

alternatives: a face with a strong square jaw
a woman with a strong square jaw
a face with a strong square jaw
a woman with a strong square jaw
items.rubric: Annotate apparent jaw geometry separately from perceived gender presentation. These are appearance judgments, not identity labels.
items.falsifier: The lexical conjunction ranks apparent presentation but ignores jaw form.
items.evidence: Proposed operationalization from the project framework; exact wording and utility unvalidated.

alternatives: a face with upturned mouth corners
a face with wrinkles beside the outer corners of the eyes
items.rubric: Annotate visible mouth curvature, cheek raising and outer-eye wrinkling separately; do not annotate actual sincerity.

alternatives: a face partly hidden in shadow
a face lit by warm orange light
a face lit by cool blue light
items.rubric: Distinguish illumination from intrinsic skin reflectance; mark if the two cannot be separated visually.
items.falsifier: Warm-light prompt detects skin tone despite matched illumination anchors.
items.evidence: Image-condition mechanism is plausible; exact color-temperature detector and impression effects are hypotheses.

comparison_rule: Replace whole alternative sets with the background bank fixed. Compare retrieval validity and predictive utility separately. No default semantic cutoff or hand-assigned coefficient sign.
